q: Topos theory provides a categorical framework for logic and geometry. A Grothendieck topos is a category equivalent to a category of sheaves on a site. In dynamical systems, the topos of discrete dynamical systems (sets with endomorphism) classifies:
opts: Orbits, periodic points, and invariant sets via the internal logic of the topos
exp: The topos Set^ℕ (functors ℕ → Set, or sets equipped with an endomorphism) has internal logic where 'always true' means 'eventually true'. Periodic orbits, eventual periodicity, and invariant subsets can all be described internally. This gives a topos-theoretic approach to discrete dynamics.
